title: Full 2026 Endorsements
generalEvidence: Page dated "October 8, 2026": "Our endorsements for 2026, as voted on by the Santa Monica Democratic Club membership." Every race listed is on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot, after the June 2 primary.
whyItCounts: Chartered Democratic club in Santa Monica that endorses in local races (55% threshold) and took a position opposing AB 1740.
notes: Source is a news report; the club's own site was not found (smdems.org, smdemocrats.org do not resolve). No City Council endorsement (no consensus); no consensus on the fourth SMMUSD seat (Lieberman vs Leshner). Not to be confused with Santa Monicans for Renters' Rights (already merged).

removed.name: Soledad Marcial
removed.office: City of Santa Monica, Member of the Rent Control Board
removed.reason: Not endorsed. The Santa Monica Next article says she earned an endorsement, but the club's own results page (santamonicademocrats.com/local-endorsement-results/) shows she got 33% in Round Two (55% needed) and its endorsed list and Full 2026 Endorsements page name only Thomason, Himmelrich and Gonska for Rent Control Board.

verify.note: Santa Monica Next attributes the endorsements to the club (July 15, 2026 meeting) and they match the club's own pages except Marcial (news error). Club site exists at santamonicademocrats.com (smdems.com redirects there). betterUrl page shows the same local list plus many more endorsements not in this file, listed in verify.extraOnBetterUrl for the caller to decide (not added to entries). Names on the club page: 'Luis Barrera Castañon', 'Kera Blades Snell'. Rebuilt from the club page (betterUrl) on 2026-10-18 with its 16 further picks; ballot measures left out.
